video_title: What It Takes to Win: D.Wade Checks In With Brotherhood Behind Miami’s First NBA Title

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on his admiration for Jrue Holiday's versatility
quotes.excerpt: Jrue can go both ends of the floor, he can score and he can play defense.
quotes.quote: I got to be biased and say my son. I would have to go and do that. Or Jrue Holiday. I would be either one of them because Jrue can go both ends of the floor, he can score and he can play defense.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal recalls his rivalry with Tragic Bronson
quotes.excerpt: Y'all know Tragic Bronson was starting with me. Remember when I used to get the ball and kick it on the break?
quotes.quote: Y'all know Tragic Bronson was starting with me. Remember when I used to get the ball and kick it on the break? The motherfucker turned it over. Yeah, skinny Shaq.

quotes.speaker: Udonis Haslem
quotes.summary_phrase: Udonis Haslem on the pressure of hitting a game-winner
quotes.excerpt: I had one time to shoot a game-winner. I one for one. Pat ran that motherfucker play for me.
quotes.quote: I had one time to shoot a game-winner. I one for one. Pat ran that motherfucker play for me and what happened? All draws. Udonis Haslem turns on Jamison for the win.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal on the sacrifice required to join the Heat
quotes.excerpt: When I first came here, I had to sacrifice. I was the man everywhere I went.
quotes.quote: When I first came here, I had to sacrifice. I was the man everywhere I went. But I was telling them because I had some a question. I said because I don't remember playing against them. You know who he was. Because they all know I don't look at no tape, I don't pay attention, I just come, I just show up and play.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal on his contract negotiations with Pat Riley
quotes.excerpt: I was renegotiating and Pat's so fucking smooth. I don't want to know numbers, I'm just making up a number.
quotes.quote: I was renegotiating and Pat's so fucking smooth. I don't want to know numbers, I'm just making up a number. I think it was 125 for five, or he said you could take 100 for four. And if you take 100 for four, that's when we got Posey, that's when we got Antoine, and that's when we got J-Will.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on his kidney transplant and return to the Heat
quotes.excerpt: I just come off a kidney transplant and I was like, the window is closing.
quotes.quote: I just come off a kidney transplant and I was like, the window is closing. I knew I still had a little bit left in the tank, but I wanted to be in the right situation where I could contribute.

quotes.speaker: Antoine Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Antoine Walker on the difficulty of adjusting his shot volume
quotes.excerpt: It was tough coming from 20 shots to like 10 and I had to learn how to be accurate.
quotes.quote: It was tough coming from 20 shots to like 10 and I had to learn how to be accurate at 10 and 12 shots. So that was the that probably was the hardest part.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade credits the Chicago series for defining the Heat's identity
quotes.excerpt: The Chicago series for me. It took me, and we talked about this on the show the other night.
quotes.quote: The Chicago series for me. It took me, and we talked about this on the show the other night. When we got on the road, when me and you were about to go to blows, but just how we came out of that, and I feel like at that moment, I was finding myself. And once I saw us be able to win on the road, big fella closed us out with 30 and 20, roles started to be defined.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal on the importance of a championship-winning coach
quotes.excerpt: If you didn't have a championship resume as a coach, I didn't really believe you.
quotes.quote: For me, if you didn't have a championship resume as a coach, I didn't really believe you. It was just something in me like, okay, you can coach but you haven't won.

quotes.speaker: Dorell Wright
quotes.summary_phrase: Dorell Wright on learning from his veteran teammates
quotes.excerpt: Well, you know, me being a big brother, I felt I had a bunch of big brothers.
quotes.quote: Well, you know, me being a big brother, I felt I had a bunch of big brothers. Everybody accepted me from day one. I know I used to be annoying, the guy just would laugh and always thinking shit was funny.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the Heat's accountability-based leadership
quotes.excerpt: You got to respect the coach that really truly shows some type of holding you accountable type of leadership.
quotes.quote: You got to respect the coach that really truly shows some type of holding you accountable type of leadership. When he starts doing that, holding you accountable, caring, and at the same time, initiating gathering, us coming together. He initiated a lot of that shit.

quotes.speaker: Antoine Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Antoine Walker on the team's commitment to winning
quotes.excerpt: I never wanted to let y'all down. I always wanted to be the guy that y'all could depend on.
quotes.quote: I never wanted to let y'all down. I always wanted to be the guy that y'all could depend on, whether it be to get a stop, whether it be to get a rebound, whether I needed a shot to make a shot to get you open, whether I needed to get a rebound, because big Zo straight on my ass by rebounding, whether I needed to make a pick and roll when they was doubling.
